description: Implementation of functions for converting and casting OpenGL state query values, including template functions for handling different data types and state retrieval from the GL context.

methods.name: ExpandFloatToInteger
methods.description: Converts a GLfloat to a 64-bit integer by scaling and adjusting the value.

methods.name: CastFromStateValueToInt
methods.description: Template function that converts a state value to an integer type, with special handling for float types.

methods.name: CastQueryValueToInt
methods.description: Converts a query value to an integer type, rounding if necessary.

methods.name: CastMaskValue
methods.description: Casts an unsigned int mask value to a signed GLint.

methods.name: CastFromGLintStateValue
methods.description: Template function that casts a GLint state value to a specified type.

methods.name: CastFromStateValue
methods.description: Main template function that casts a state value to a specified query type, handling various GL types.

methods.name: CastQueryValueTo
methods.description: Converts a query value to a native type, with special handling for different GL types.

methods.name: CastStateValues
methods.description: Retrieves multiple state values from the context and casts them to the specified query type.

methods.name: CastIndexedStateValues
methods.description: Retrieves indexed state values from the context and casts them to the specified query type.
